run_saco_veval_all: run video grounding evaluation for all saco_veval datasets using ground truth and prediction directories
run_saco_veval_one: run video grounding evaluation for a single dataset using ground truth annotation and prediction file paths
create_veval_evaluator: create a VEvalEvaluator instance with ground truth annotation file and output result file paths
run_veval_eval: run the VEvalEvaluator to compute mAP, phrase AP, TETA, HOTA, and cgF1 metrics and save results to JSON
summarize_saco_veval_eval: summarize the saco_veval_eval module that provides CLI subcommands for video grounding metric evaluation
